title: Reflect header
description: An 88px glassy top bar that stays over the page for the whole scroll and lets the hero run underneath: an app-icon tile and name at the left, the nav links inside a centred hairline pill, a text link and a violet button at the right, and a hairline under it that fades out at both ends. Links dim from 90% to 60% ink in 300ms. On phones: icon, button and a menu button that drops the links down (no JavaScript).
notes: sticky with a negative bottom margin: put it first at the page's top level and the next section runs under it
the phone menu is a <details> disclosure, so it works without hydration
